test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 24 men can build a wall in 6 days, then how many days will 36 men take to build a wall of the same type and of double the length?
solution:
Given:

24 men can complete a wall in 6 days

Concept used:

(M₁ × D₁)/(W₁) = (M₂ × D₂)/(W₂)

Here,

M1 = People at the 1st case

D1 = Time at the 1st case

M2 = People at the 2nd case

D2 = Time at the 2nd case 

W₁ = Work one

W2 = Work two

Calculation:

According to the concept,

M1 = 24

D1 = 6

M2 = 36

Let D2 be x

So,

[(24 × 6)/1] = [(36 × x)/2] [Here second work is two times of the first work]

⇒ 2 ×144 = 36x

⇒ x = (2 × 144)/36

⇒ x = 144/18

⇒ x = 8

So, D2 = 8 days

**∴ They will take 8 days to build a wall of the same type and of double the length.**
